correctness.rationale: Moment coefficients characterize both kernels via monomial ONB and real-analytic diagonal kernel expansion. For m>=1, all real polynomial moments vanish and the finite complex measure has an exponential moment, making each Fourier-line transform analytic in a strip, hence zero identically. For 0<m<1, explicit gamma phase sin/cos parity makes every mixed moment vanish, and the angular map has operator norm <=2 and lower bound >=1/2, hence closed infinite-dimensional image. This proves the exact sharp dichotomy for every finite d and alpha.

value.rationale: Defines and exactly resolves a natural threshold for bounded-symbol faithfulness of Berezin/Toeplitz quantization in a recently studied generalized Fock scale. In the full subcritical regime it constructs an entire closed angular L-infinity subspace of invisible symbols and distinct strictly positive bounded symbols with identical operators; this is a structural and norm-topological phenomenon, not a single routine example or mere finite computation.
